meta.title: DSH TaskBridge
meta.description: Cross-host task delegation bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): let your upper host focus on architecture planning and delivery review while offloading heavy coding and test loops to DSH to save flagship model quota. Centralizes API, model, and reasoning-effort routing with Git worktree isolation, cross-subtask reuse, one-click host setup, low-overhead direct calls, silent waiting, scoped approvals, post-review write-back confirmation, and linked cleanup (supports Codex and Antigravity; Claude Code / Claude Desktop planned for 2.0).
